Equipment:
Fire Fighting System
 for 
Main & aux. and common Transformers
(1AT10, 2AT10), (1BT10, 2BT10), OBT10

This document out lists the testing procedure
 P1, which must be carried out every six months as 
 indicate by M6 in the above title block.

This document outlines how to check & schedule 
 maintenance fire fighting program for out door transformers, in first unit and 
 second unit.

The equipment have pressure water source 10 bar 
 through deluge valve, output nozzle 0.5inch diameter, thermal eight sensors 
 to sensing temperature at 80 C, and terminal control box FCI. in first unit & scorpidio in second unit feeded by 220V source or 24 v.dc u.s.a. American 
 unit.

The first draft prepared by eng. Moustfa Awadi, tested by 
 eng. Adel Shawki & Safety eng. Ashraf Gaber at 10 May 2003, 
 revised by quality control eng. i & c Abdl Menem Al Emam & EDEPC 
 Safety eng. Medhat Kater, approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy sector head of Talkha 
 Power station, and certified by eng. Aly Mostafa AL Lethy EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control head sector.

items:

 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,

Safety fence (rope) with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear your safety helmet, shoes
 . etc.

The unit and 
 transformer must be out of service
Digital Multimeter type Fluke 85

Screw 
 drive and French spanner
Safe flam source as flam match.
Adjustable spanner.

Transformer must be out of service and .per 
 mated isolation by operator eng.

items:
Transformer must be out of service and .per 
 mated isolation by operator eng. 
 Department

Starting flame source nearest the sensor to reach 
 temperature around transformer more than 80 C then sensor energized.

When sensor energized the fire fighting system activated & starting alarm 
 Horne with flashing lamp panel, the water isolating valve automatically open 
 to push water around transformer to cooling it.

If the sensor signal not come to the control unit panel ( step 3 ) then check 
 wiring cable sensors and control unit and attended fault.

To test manual riles close the isolating valve, return deluge valve and reset 
 alarm (system normalized)
Open the isolating valve.

Bull down manual riles (ON) system will energized and water start to pushing 
 around transformer to cooling

If system not activated, then check manual 
 relies and wire.
Return the manual riles to it is position (OFF)
Make rest from control panel for horn and flasher .
Return the deluge valve on water pipe in close position .
Open the isolating valve on water pipe slowly .
